name: Youtaro Oosato
original_name: オオサト ヨウタロウ
source: Tsuki's subordinate and one of the protagonists of the Matchmaker story. [spoiler]A glorified hitman working for the government. His job is to kill anyone who threatens to disrupt the perfection of the 25th Ward.[/spoiler]
